arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Hart argued the Ninth Circuit correctly invalidated the arrest. She stated the officers were personally liable for damages.
Mr. Phillips argued the closely related offense doctrine protects constitutional rights. He claimed it prevents arrests for non-criminal conduct.
Mr. Comey argued Fourth Amendment validity requires an objective assessment. He viewed the facts through a specific legal prism.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the closely related offense doctrine. This rule allows arrests for minor, non-criminal acts if they relate to a crime. The Ninth Circuit rejected this rule here. The officers argue the rule protects constitutional rights.
